title: My favorite theater program is BACK!  As a champion of theater access...
transcript: You do not have to pay hundreds of dollars to see your favorite celebrities on stage as audible and Together Theatre are doing another summer season where they are producing celebrity driven plays in a tiny intimate off Broadway theatre. And 25% of the tickets in the theatre are sold for $35 through day of digital and in person rush. This year they are doing three plays including the return engagement of sexual misconduct of the Middle Class starring Hugh Jackman and Ella Beatty. It was one of my favorite plays I saw last year, so glad it's back and that is finishing up its run on April 30th. Their second play which just began performances is called What Happened was. It stars Cecily Strong and Corey Stoll as two characters on a first date. The date takes some wild twists and turns and the entire time you're wondering are they toxic or are they perfect for each other? And as someone who is single, the ending hit surprisingly hard. This play is running now through June 14th and will run in rep with their third play New born, also starring Hugh Jackman along with Marianna Gailus and Sepideh Moafi with their first performance being May 8th and their final performance being June 8th. But again they are running in rep so be sure to check the calendar to know what show is on when. And if you want those 35 dollar tickets you can either get in person rush at the theatre starting at Noon or 35 dollar day of lottery tickets on today tix starting at five PM.
